deploy-bot: Canary health degraded for release=payments-gateway, ns=prod, chart=payments-chart v3.0.0 (previous v2.9.8). Canary health: 0.60 (threshold 0.85). Observed spike in p95 latency and a rise in 5xxs after values override applied. Recommendation: PAUSE canary and add values override or pin chart. Details:
```
release: payments-gateway
canary: 5% traffic -> 10% scheduled
metric: p95_latency / error_rate
baseline_p95: 120ms
canary_p95: 420ms
changed_values:
  global.logging.level: info -> debug
  payments.sidecar.replicas: 3 -> 1
  payments.features.experimentalX: false -> true
commit: a1b2c3d (PR #3302)
```

sam lee: Who merged PR #3302? That replicas drop looks suspicious for a stateful endpoint.
maria chen: That was merged by tok PR from infra-team to reduce costs in non-prod but seems default made it into chart.
caroline ng: If experimentalX flips it might trigger a data path that hits a slower codepath. We should avoid rolling back DB migrations.
ben thompson: Options: 1) Pin chart to v2.9.8 and continue 2) Patch canary values: set payments.sidecar.replicas=3 + experimentalX=false (surgical) 3) Full rollback to previous release (safer but noisy). I'm for surgical patch.
sam lee: Surgical sounds right. If we patch values we keep the new chart metadata but restore runtime behaviour. We should also add a temporary resource bump for the sidecar.
maria chen: I'll apply a canary values override: payments.sidecar.replicas=3, payments.sidecar.resources.requests.cpu=250m, payments.features.experimentalX=false. Applying now.
deploy-bot: Values override applied by maria chen. Recomputing canary health...
deploy-bot: Canary health 0.93. Auto-unpause scheduled at change-window 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Manual hold remains.
release-notes-bot: Draft note created: "payments-gateway: postponed chart upgrade (v3.0.0) due to runtime latency when experimental feature enabled; applied canary values override to restore stability. PR: https://github.com/redwood/payments-gateway/pull/3302"
caroline ng: Add the metric snapshot and exact canary diffs to the incident tracker. Also schedule a staging canary to test v3.0.0 with feature disabled and sidecar resource limits.
ben thompson: I'll open a follow-up ticket to add a chart lint rule that forbids lowering replicas default in stable charts and to add an e2e that exercises experimentalX codepath.
maria chen: Created ticket RED-4123 and linked to the rollout. Calendar invite for postmortem tomorrow 10:30 PT.
sam lee: Note for release ops: include the pinned chart note in the weekly changelog and call out the surgical override.
